abstract: Comprehensive React and Vite SPA performance, architecture, and deployment guidelines covering 11 rules across 3 categories. This skill should be used when building, reviewing, or refactoring React applications built with Vite (SPA). Targets React 19, Vite 8, React Router 8, and TanStack Query v5: Vite static hosting and caching requirements, build validation, environment variables, route-level code splitting, server state, memoization with React Compiler, image optimization, colocation, and troubleshooting.
